title: mentha longifolia var. leioneura
intro: Mentha longifolia var. leioneura, commonly known as Lion's Herb or Long-Leaved Pennyroyal, is a perennial herb belonging to the mint family (Lamiaceae). It is valued for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, relieving digestive issues, and acting as a natural antiseptic. The therapeutic actions of Mentha longifolia var. leioneura include its carminative properties, which help alleviate flatulence and nausea, as well as its antispasmodic properties, which soothe muscle cramps and spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include essential oils, such as menthone, isomenthone, and limonene, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
